The issuer shows solid operating profitability (EBIT of 2,334M on revenue of 8,669M, ~27% margin), supporting debt-service capacity. However, liquidity is weak with a current ratio of 0.63 and current liabilities substantially exceeding current assets, indicating higher near-term refinancing/working-capital risk. Leverage is also relatively high (total liabilities 139,666M vs. total assets 192,293M), tempering the credit profile.  

DECISION: BB+
